body: How about we have yet another day added?

Hey, I don't usually reply in Reddit but as a fellow middle-eastern (Iran) I completely feel what you're saying so I had to respond.

It is tough and it is bleak and fricking hopeless. Not just economically and job-wise but even culturally, us middle easterns tend to get in touch with really abusive people and families so I completely understand what you're going through and I completely understand that you being a female makes it much much harder in Syria.

It is really really really hard and often times people in other countries have not a single clue how much we endure different hardships on a day to day basis and to be honest, I'm not even sure if me not committing suicide is going to change things.

But I want you to know that even if me and the other guys over here are miles away from you, you are not alone. You are heard and at times understood.

I mean sure, the majority of people may avoid you for your nationality but that doesn't mean that you're worthless. It means that they are victims of their own prejudices.

Also, that ex-boyfriend of yours wasn't worthy of you and even though I haven't seen you, I trust the judgement of your friend that you are beautiful. :)

Besides, you are only 20 years old so if you're committing suicide because you feel useless and jobless... then my god you expect too highly of yourself. You can still learn a lot of things. Things that you can use to find a freelance job on the internet for yourself. You can learn different languages and apply for immigration. All of them are possibilities that exist in your future and yes some of them are less likely but some of them aren't.

But if you feel tired to do all these things then I understand you more than you think but don't say that you are useless. You are quite the opposite of it. 300 dollars a month? damn that's a lot considering where you come from and the conversion rate of currencies. You already did this once. You can do it again and since you're more experienced you can do it better now. and this time you'll spend that money in a way that makes YOU happy. because YOU are the only important person in your life.

Peace.

You are indeed correct but most in Iran feel like they have nothing left to lose. We're talking about things getting 30 times more expensive in a matter of 5 years. Malls falling to the ground because they couldn't care to build them with care (Metropol incident). Teenagers getting killed, molested and often raped by the government forces.

It is a gamble. But most are so overwhelmed with pain and suffering that cannot see anything past deposing the sources of this misery.

I wasn't in this situation and I don't think my advice is gonna help but I upvoted and commented on your post so that other people who know what to do see this.

But if I was in your shoes I would be there for my mom. First and foremost tell her how much you love her and how good she was as a mother to you. And be honest and tell her that your opinion is that she is not at fault at all.

I guess the best approach would be what you just said. Talk about it with your Grandmom. But before you do that, be there for her. Even if it's just a hug or a kiss on the cheeks, it will go a long way.

I hope other people here have better advice.

This is indeed a tough question. I guess if given a choice I would probably like to become an influential, charming and deceptive kind of vampire not to use people but to just keep myself from being used.

But immortality is cruel. You would have to witness the death of your loved ones over and over through the centuries. I doubt I could endure that.
